# Money Task (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Money Task` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 9 actions on 3 resources, 3 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-moneytasklist) | `GET /moneyTaskList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}&TaskType={TaskType}` |
| [GET](#get-moneyoperation) | `GET /moneyOperation?TaskID={TaskID}` |
| [POST](#post-moneyoperation) | `POST /moneyOperation` |
| [PUT](#put-moneyoperation) | `PUT /moneyOperation` |
| [DELETE](#delete-moneyoperation) | `DELETE /moneyOperation?ID={ID}&Void={Void}` |
| [GET](#get-banktransfer) | `GET /bankTransfer?TaskID={TaskID}` |
| [POST](#post-banktransfer) | `POST /bankTransfer` |
| [PUT](#put-banktransfer) | `PUT /bankTransfer` |
| [DELETE](#delete-banktransfer) | `DELETE /bankTransfer?ID={ID}&Void={Void}` |


## Money Task List

Path: `/moneyTaskList`

### Available fields for Money Task List
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         |          |  Unique ID.        |
| `Date`  | DateTime           |         |          |Date  of money operation.  |
| `TaskType`  | String           |         |          |Task Type. Available values are `Spend Money`, `Receive Money`, `Transfer Money`         |
| `Status`  | String           |         |          |Inventory Write-Off Task Status. Available values are `DRAFT`, `COMPLETED`, `VOIDED`         |
| `SupplierCustomerName`  | String           |         |          |Customer or Supplier who recive/spend money.      |
| `SupplierID`  | Guid           |         |          |Supplier ID   |
| `CustomerID`  | Guid           |         |          |Customer ID   |
| `Reference`  | Decimal           |         |          |Custom reference    |
| `TotalAmount`  | String           |         |          |Operation total amount.     |

<a id="get-moneytasklist"></a>
### GET /moneyTaskList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}&TaskType={TaskType}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page (Default: 1)
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100. (Default: 100)
- `Status` (optional): "Only return Money Task with specified status (Default: null)
- `Search` (optional): Only return Money Task with search value contained in one of these fields: SupplierCustomerName, Reference, BankAccountCode, Memo, TotalAmount, CustomField(1-10) (Default: null)
- `TaskType` (optional): "Only return Money Task with specified TaskType (Default: null)

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 6,
  "Page": 1,
  "MoneyTasks": [
    {
      "TaskID": "07a2cdde-6a04-4925-be45-538e3a88dd7a",
      "Date": "2018-01-17T00:00:00",
      "TaskType": "Receive Money",
      "Status": "COMPLETED",
      "SupplierCustomerName": "",
      "SupplierID": null,
      "CustomerID": null,
      "Reference": "",
      "TotalAmount": 6
    },
    {
      "TaskID": "ded51119-ec29-4fcd-b43b-4c63341f188e",
      "Date": "2018-01-17T00:00:00",
      "TaskType": "Spend Money",
      "Status": "COMPLETED",
      "SupplierCustomerName": "Bayside Wholesale",
      "SupplierID": "af09cddc-c4b0-47b2-8755-78edac52e920",
      "CustomerID": null,
      "Reference": "Test 1",
      "TotalAmount": 1.8
    }
  ]
}
```

## Money Operation

Path: `/moneyOperation`

+ This endpoint is used to work with `Receive Money` and `Spend Money` money tasks.

### Available fields for Money Task List
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         |Yes*|  Unique ID. Required for PUT       |
| `TaskType`  | String           |         |     Yes     |Task Type. Available values are `Spend Money`, `Receive Money`, `Transfer Money`         |
| `Status`  | String           |         |    Yes      |Money Task Status. Available values are `DRAFT`, `COMPLETED`, `VOIDED`         |
| `BankAccount` | String |     |     Yes     | Bank Account Number.|
| `CurrencyConversionRate` | Decimal |     |          | Conversion rate between `BankAccount` currency and base currency. If not passed, will be calculated automatically as base currency / bank account currency.|
| `SupplierCustomerName`  | String           |         |          |Customer or Supplier who recive/spend money.      |
| `SupplierID`  | Guid           |         |          |Supplier ID. `CustomerID` and `SupplierID` are mutually exclusive.   |
| `CustomerID`  | Guid           |         |          |Customer ID. `CustomerID` and `SupplierID` are mutually exclusive.  |
| `Reference`  | String           |         |          |Custom reference    |
| `Date`  | DateTime           |         |     Yes     |Date  of money operation.  |
| `TaxInclusive`  | Boolean           |         |          |`true` if inclusive. Default false.  |
| `Note`  | String           |         |          |Custom note.  |
| `Lines`  |<a href="#MoneyTaskLineModel"><b>[] Money Task Line Model</b></a>|         |          |        |
| `Transactions`  |<a href="#TransactionStockLineModel"><b>[] Transaction Stock Line Model</b></a>|         |          |        |
|`Attachments`|<a href="#AttachmentLineModel"><b>[] Attachment Line Model</b></a>|||Sale Attachments|

<a id="delete-moneyoperation"></a>
### DELETE /moneyOperation?ID={ID}&Void={Void}

## Bank Transfer

Path: `/bankTransfer`

### Available fields for Money Task List
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         |Yes*|  Unique ID. Required for PUT       |
| `Status`  | String           |         |    Yes      |Bank Transfer Status. Available values are `DRAFT`, `COMPLETED`, `VOIDED`         |
| `FromAccount` | String |     |     Yes     |From Bank Account Number.|
| `ToAccount` | String |     |     Yes     |To Bank Account Number.|
| `FromAmount` | Decimal |     |     Yes     |From Amount. In `From Bank Account` currency.|
| `ToAmount` | Decimal |     |     Yes     | To Amount. In `To Bank Account` currency.|
| `CurrencyConversionRate` | Decimal |     |          | Conversion rate between `BankAccount` currency and base currency. Will be calculated automatically as `From Bank Account` currency / `To Bank Account` currency.|
| `Reference`  | String           |         |          |Custom reference    |
| `Date`  | DateTime           |         |     Yes     |Date of Bank Transfer.  |
| `Note`  | String           |         |          |Custom note.  |
| `Transactions`  |<a href="#TransactionStockLineModel"><b>[] Transaction Stock Line Model</b></a>|         |          |        |
|`Attachments`|<a href="#AttachmentLineModel"><b>[] Attachment Line Model</b></a>|||Sale Attachments|
